m.english: No leads on Malcolm, but I got here as soon as I could.

target.text: Não há pistas sobre o Malcolm, mas vim assim que pude.

translation.text: No leads on Malcolm, but I got here as soon as I could.

m.target: Não há pistas sobre o Malcolm, mas vim assim que pude.

m.english: Now we're stuck in the middle of Bulgaria with no leads and no time.

target.text: Agora estou preso no meio da Bulgária, sem pistas e sem tempo.

translation.text: Now we're stuck in the middle of Bulgaria with no leads and no time.

m.target: Agora estou preso no meio da Bulgária, sem pistas e sem tempo.

m.english: I just can't find any clues as to why she needs our help.

target.text: Só não consigo encontrar pistas de que precisa da nossa ajuda.

translation.text: I just can't find any clues as to why she needs our help.

m.target: Só não consigo encontrar pistas de que precisa da nossa ajuda.

m.english: To see it, you need only the smallest of clues.

target.text: Para o ver, precisamos apenas da mais pequena das pistas.

translation.text: To see it, you need only the smallest of clues.

m.target: Para o ver, precisamos apenas da mais pequena das pistas.

m.english: If we could find the crime scene, and maybe we could find some more clues.

target.text: Se encontrarmos o local do crime podemos encontrar mais pistas.

translation.text: If we could find the crime scene, and maybe we could find some more clues.

m.target: Se encontrarmos o local do crime podemos encontrar mais pistas.

u.english: But I don't think he was trying to leave any breadcrumbs out there for anybody to follow.

target.text: Mas não acho que estivesse a tentar deixar pistas para alguém seguir.

translation.text: But I don't think he was trying to leave any breadcrumbs out there for anybody to follow.

u.target: Mas não acho que estivesse a tentar deixar pistas para alguém seguir.

u.english: Did they have him give you any helpful tips on how to do that?

target.text: E disse algumas pistas em como fazer isso?

translation.text: Did they have him give you any helpful tips on how to do that?

u.target: E disse algumas pistas em como fazer isso?

u.english: I found the clues or whatever.

target.text: Eu vi as... pistas, ou o que fossem.

translation.text: I found the clues or whatever.

u.target: Eu vi as... pistas, ou o que fossem.

u.english: Which is what one of the big leads was yesterday.

target.text: Que tem a ver com uma das pistas importantes que recebemos ontem.

translation.text: Which is what one of the big leads was yesterday.

u.target: Que tem a ver com uma das pistas importantes que recebemos ontem.
